description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the retention of the existing development consisting of aluminium access gangway and associated brackets, supports rollers, 60mm by 40mm top and bottom rails, 38mm aluminium box section trust and 750mm wide aluminium chequer plate walkway panels spanning between the bottom rails, an access bridge which has a horizontal distance of 5m at the southern most point of Smith Hill, access to the mooring through a secure access gate with intercom system on Smith Hill,  underground installation of a 63mm MDPE barrier Pipe, timber buffer, service connections to the vessel via the underside of the access bridge, electrical consumer unit wall cabinet, water stop cock wall cabinet, foul sewage connection to the mooring, water and electric supplies wall mounted at high level, with a BT feed run within a planter, secure storage facility housing electricity and water metres and fencing along eastern boundary at Smith Hill.
